notes.title_strength: Clear binary question, but 'which one doubles' is slightly clunky.

notes.clickbait_risk: Sip-vs-gulp framing slightly reshapes what the experiments actually compared.

pick_reason: P3 is the most accurate and least baity package, its title echoes the spoken hook ('doubles your odds') and its numeric thumbnail reads clearly on a phone. P1 has a stronger hook match and more curiosity but stretches 'doubles' onto a sip-vs-gulp comparison the evidence doesn't directly make.
